svg.title: SPATHI-benchmarks (FULL)
svg.desc: Manual programmatic vector reconstruction of the AI-generated reference; not the original source of that raster image. All icons and text are redrawn; the reference PNG is never read by the builder.

g.text: 14 synthetic datasets with variation in topology,
Run the frozen policy and comparison methods
Methods grouped by information and assumptions
Same metrics for all methods, paired by dataset
One method at a time with fixed resources
Thread scaling on the medium dataset
1 CPU, standard CPUs, and all CPUs
Measure runtime, memory, and feasibility frontier
Track performance and stop when infeasible
If a route fails at one size,
stop that route at larger sizes.
Later blocked runs are marked not attempted.
From parameter search to fair held-out evaluation and scalability testing
S P A T H I
Semantic seed 734921 · fixed CPU/RAM plan · SQLite journal · atomic artifacts
HTML reports + CSV tables + provenance files

svg.text: Synthetic data only · counts are planned protocol quantities, not measured results.
